initial:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: redesigned daily weather map for the educational iLMeteo site.
Input image 1: EDIT TARGET and authoritative data/geography reference, the Italy daily forecast map for Friday 9 October. Input image 2: STYLE REFERENCE only, the new navy/orange/icy-blue weather icon atlas.
Primary request: redesign image 1 in the clean flat graphic style of image 2. This is a faithful visual restyling of an existing forecast, NOT creation of a new forecast.
Composition: retain the same portrait aspect ratio 425:460, same Italy coastline silhouette, neighboring land, Sicily/Sardinia positions, same geographic crop, same weather icon locations. No stretching or new locations. Replace each small weather pictogram with a tiny crisp pictogram in the reference family: orange suns #dc5700, dark navy #092b60 outlines, pale blue #c9d9e9 clouds and blue #064ec3 raindrops. Preserve the condition of EACH source symbol at its original location: sunny remains sunny, sun+cloud remains sun+cloud, rainy source icons must retain raindrops and a sun when the source has both. Do not change sunny/rainy patterns, remove or add forecasts.
Map styling: white/light icy-blue sea, restrained pale blue land, thin navy/blue coastlines and internal geographic outlines. Flat fills and crisp edges; no terrain texture, gradients, haze, shadows, frames or decorative icons. Preserve every wind/marine marker at its exact location and original direction, redrawn in readable navy. Keep all marks legible without overcrowding.
STRICT DATA INVARIANTS: retain the two-column temperature table at upper right with EXACTLY these rows and values, using small clear sans-serif typography:
AO 9 21 | PG 15 21
TO 15 21 | RN 19 23
MI 16 21 | AQ 14 19
TN 14 23 | PE 20 27
BZ 12 23 | CB 15 18
VE 17 19 | NA 21 22
TS 16 20 | BA 21 27
GE 18 22 | PZ 15 21
BO 16 21 | CZ 19 26
FI 16 24 | PA 21 25
AN 20 23 | CA 18 24
Minimum cells blue and maximum cells orange; preserve each value verbatim. Do not use generated temperatures or rearrange table rows.
Bottom footer: retain EXACT text "Venerdì 9" on the left and "iLMeteo" on the right. Keep attribution legible in a simple navy/orange footer consistent with the redesign. No additional claims, dates or wording.
Final output: one finished high-resolution portrait map, opaque white background, no presentation board or mockup, no watermark. Protect source geography, source weather distribution and every printed value.
